parameters.name: ClothClass
parameters.description:
The clothing category. Valid values:
- tops: Upper garment
- coat: Outerwear
- skirt: Skirt/Dress
- pants: Trousers
- bag: Bag
- shoes: Shoes
- hat: Hat

parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The image URL. We recommend using an OSS link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in a non-Shanghai region OSS, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: OutMode
parameters.description:
The type of segmentation result to return, which affects the content returned in the ImageURL field. This is an optional parameter.

- 0 (default): The default main clothing segmentation result.

- 1: A combined segmentation result of user-specified class categories.

parameters.name: ReturnForm
parameters.description:
Specifies the format of the returned image. Valid values:

- whiteBK: Returns a white background image.
- mask: Returns a single-channel mask.
- If not set, a four-channel PNG image is returned.
> - This parameter only applies to the output ImageURL. It does not affect ClassUrl, which always returns a mask channel image.
